response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, senior engineer with strong distributed-systems and low-latency experience (Sociomantic) and some geospatial exposure via his open-source GISCollective project, but his recent and primary expertise is in TypeScript/Node.js full-stack work rather than modern C++ or Rust, which are the core required skills for this routing-tiling role. His C++ experience is largely historical (2014-2015, plus a university thesis) and not reflected in his current skills list, making him a weak match for a role centered on C++/Rust production pipelines.
strengths: Deep distributed-systems and low-latency service experience (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby)
Relevant geospatial domain exposure through founding and maintaining GISCollective
Strong generalist engineering background with demonstrated ability to learn new stacks quickly
concerns: No current or recent C++ or Rust experience; core language requirement not met
No direct navigation/routing pipeline or tiling experience
Career trajectory has shifted heavily toward web/product engineering (TypeScript, Node.js) away from systems programming

key_factors.factor: Distributed systems and low-latency engineering background
